run.generator: synthetic sample (hand-made, not a pipeline run)

views.label: Used in projects
views.measures: Use in websites (55%), code (30%) and apps (15%).

views.label: Desktop: most chosen
views.measures: Fonts people install on purpose. Fonts that Linux systems install on their own are ranked on their other sources.

views.label: Desktop: most installed
views.measures: Fonts on the most computers, counting every install.

views.label: Coding fonts
views.measures: Monospace fonts, ranked by developers' installs and downloads.

views.label: Developers & apps
views.measures: What builders choose: npm packages, projects that depend on them, and app frameworks. All its sources come from npm, one kind of evidence, so no font gets an exact rank yet.

views.label: Rising (beta)
views.measures: Fonts gaining share over the last 3 months.

views.label: Overall
views.measures: Desktop installs people chose and use in sites, code and apps, half each.

tiers.A: Firm: evidence from at least 2 kinds of source, and the rank is unlikely to move far.
tiers.B: Fair: the rank could move by about its own size.
